The {{Term/Store|Champion|Champions|Series, BotW, AoC|plural}},{{Exp Game|BotW, AoC}}<ref>{{Cite|We selected four skilled individuals from across Hyrule and tasked them with the duty of piloting the Divine Beasts. With the princess as their commander, we dubbed these pilots Champions—a name that would solidify their unique bond.|King Rhoam|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|The pilots of the Divine Beasts and the knight with the key to defeating Calamity Ganon... In a grand ceremony, these five heroes convened, and King Rhoam bestowed upon each the title of Champion. The people gave cheer, the ceremony drew to an end, and the Champions enjoyed a moment of rest.|Narration|AoC}}</ref> also known as the '''Team Champion''',{{Exp Game|AoC}}<ref>{{Cite|Defeat {{Color AoC|Red|Team Champion}}!|Battle Log|AoC}}</ref>, and the '''Four Champions''',{{Exp Game|AoC}}<ref>{{Cite|The Four Champions are moving to support the descendant units!|Battle Log|AoC}}</ref> are a team of warriors chosen from the five prominent races of [[Hyrule]] to battle against [[Calamity Ganon]]. Led by [[Princess Zelda]], the team consists of the [[Hylian]] [[Link]], who wields the [[Master Sword]] against the Calamity, and four other Champions who pilot the [[Divine Beast]]s in support.

==Biography==
==={{BotW|-}}===
10,000 years ago, the [[Sheikah]] constructed the [[Divine Beast]]s to combat the [[Calamity Ganon|Calamity]]. Four unknown individuals were chosen to pilot them.{{Fact}} Together with the guardians, the hero and the princess, the four Champions and their Divine Beasts were successful in sealing away the Calamity, if only temporarily. They are never seen in-game; the only time they appear is on the [[Calamity Ganon Tapestry]] and when [[Impa]] tells Link the tale of 10-millennia prior. It is not known whether their races correspond with the races of the current champions.

[[File:BotW Champions' Appointment.png|thumb|left|The formal appointment of the Champions by King Rhoam]]
After the Divine Beasts and [[Guardian]]s are unearthed and the plot to defeat Calamity Ganon was created, the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]] choose a representative from each of Hyrule's races, with Princess Zelda personally approaching each of the four Champions to ask for their help. They are joined with the Hero chosen by the Master Sword to protect the Princess and together face the Calamity. The four Champions overcome trials to prove themselves worthy of piloting the Divine Beasts.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 360}}</ref> After a suggestion from Daruk,<ref>{{Cite|Wasn't this your idea?|Revali|BotW}}</ref> the Champions attend an official ceremony and watch as Princess Zelda declares Link the Hero of Hyrule.<ref>{{Cite|Hero of Hyrule, chosen by the sword that seals the darkness... You have shown unflinching bravery and skill in the face of darkness and adversity. And have proven yourself worthy of the blessings of the Goddess Hylia.|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> Though Daruk notes that Zelda is treating the ceremony as if they had already lost and Revali complains that the ceremonial grandeur is overkill,<ref>{{Cite|Gee, this is uplifting... She's making it sound like we already lost.|Daruk|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|You're the one who wanted to designate the appointed knight with all the ceremonial pomp, grandeur, and nonsense we could muster! And if you ask me, the whole thing does seem to be overkill.|Revali|BotW}}</ref> Urbosa speculates that Zelda may see Link as the embodiment of her own failures.<ref>{{Cite|That boy is a living reminder of her own failures. Well, at least that's how the princess sees him.|Urbosa|BotW}}</ref> Following the ceremony, Zelda continues research on the Divine Beasts and the [[Ancient Shrine]]s so that the Champions will be better able to face Calamity Ganon.<ref>{{Cite|However, it's apparent that we still have much more to learn. [...] That means we should be able to understand how it works and how to use it to our advantage. These Divine Beasts... so much we don't know...|Zelda|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|It appears that this structure was designed to be exclusively accessed by the sword's chosen one. But designs can always be worked around, at least I hope. How do I get inside...?|Zelda|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|From here we'll make our way to Goron City. Then, we'll need some adjustments on that Divine Beast so that Daruk can manage it as easily as possible.|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> However, she is ordered by her father, [[King Rhoam]], to cease wasting time on these studies and focus on her attempts to awaken her sealing power.<ref>{{Cite|No more excuses, Zelda! Stop running away from your duty. As the king, I forbid you to have anything to do with these machines from this moment on and command you to focus on your training.|King Rhoam|BotW}}</ref> Zelda begins her own ceremonies at the [[Spring of Courage|Springs of Courage]], [[Spring of Power|Power]], and [[Spring of Wisdom|Wisdom]],<ref>{{Cite|I come seeking help... regarding this power that has been handed down over time... Prayer will awaken my power to seal Ganon away... Or so I've been told all my life...|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> finding herself increasingly frustrated when she feels none of the sealing power she is expected to use within her, but still holds onto the hope of success.<ref>{{Cite|I've prayed at the Spring of Courage and at the Spring of Power, yet neither awoke anything inside me. But maybe up there... Perhaps the Spring of Wisdom, the final of the three, will be the one. To be honest, I have no real reason to think that will be the case. But there's always the chance that the next moment will change everything.|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> As she and Link descend [[Mount Lanayru]] at the end of her third failure at the Spring of Wisdom,<ref>{{Cite|So you didn't feel anything? No power at all?|Revali|BotW}}</ref> the Champions are there to ask how it went.<ref>{{Cite|Well? Don't keep us in suspense. How'd everything go up there on the mountain?|Daruk|BotW}}</ref> Though Mipha begins to offer a recommendation from her own experience in using magic,<ref>{{Cite|If I may... I thought you... Well, I'm not sure how to put this into words... I'm actually quite embarrassed to say it. But I was thinking about what I do when I'm healing. You know, what usually goes through my mind... It helps when I think--when I think about--|Mipha|BotW}}</ref> they are interrupted when Calamity Ganon surfaces.<ref>{{Cite|It's awake. Ganon!|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> Sprung into action, Daruk directs the other Champions to their Divine Beasts and tells Link to get ready to battle.<ref>{{Cite|Let's stop wasting time! We're gonna need everything we got to take that thing down! Now Champions! To your Divine Beasts! Show that swirling swine who's boss! Link will need to meet Ganon head on when we attack! This needs to be a unified assault! Little guy! You get to Hyrule Castle. You can count on us for support. But it's up to you to pound Ganon into oblivion!|Daruk|BotW}}</ref> Though Urbosa attempts to escort her to safety,<ref>{{Cite|Come. We should go. We need to get you someplace safe.|Urbosa|BotW}}</ref> Zelda insists that they include her in the fight.<ref>{{Cite|I'm not a child anymore! I may not be much use on the battlefield... But there must... There must be something I can do to help!|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> However, it all backfires when Calamity Ganon possesses the Guardians and Divine Beasts while the lives of Daruk, Mipha, Revali, and Urbosa are lost, as the now corrupted machinery attacked the kingdom.<ref>{{Cite|How... How did it come to this? The Divine Beasts... The Guardians... They've all turned against us... It was... Calamity Ganon. It turned them all against us! And everyone--Mipha, Urbosa, Revali and Daruk... They're all trapped inside those things...|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> Link and Zelda flee to a forest and Zelda breaks into tears over their failure.<ref>{{Cite|It's all my fault! Our only hope for defeating Ganon is lost all because I couldn't harness this cursed power! Everything--everything I've done up until now... It was all for nothing... So I really am just a failure!|Zelda|BotW}}</ref>As they near [[Fort Hateno]], Link's injuries start to get the better of him as Zelda begs him to save himself and leave her.<ref>{{Cite|Link, save yourself! Go! I'll be fine! Don't worry about me! Run!|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> Her attempts to protect him cause her to accidentally awaken her sealing power, deactivating all of the Guardians in the area.<ref>{{Cite|Was... Was that...? The power...|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> However, she finds she is too late as she sees Link has collapsed and attempts to encourage him as he falls unconscious.<ref>{{Cite|No, no... Link! Get up! You're going to be just fine...|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> She is momentarily heartbroken, though [[Fi|a voice within the Master Sword]] encourages her that it is not too late to save him.<ref>{{Cite|The sword...? So he can... He can still be saved?|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> She orders two arriving Sheikah to have Link placed in the [[Shrine of Resurrection]], where he will be healed.<ref>{{Cite|Take Link to the Shrine of Resurrection. If you don't get him there immediately, we are going to lose him forever! Is that clear?! So make haste and go! His life is now in your hands!|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> Zelda, filled with hope, takes the Master Sword to the [[Korok Forest]] and places it under the watchful eye of the [[Great Deku Tree]], assuring it that its master will one day return.<ref>{{Cite|Your master will come for you. Until then, you shall rest safely here.|Zelda|BotW}}</ref> She then sets off to [[Hyrule Castle]] to do her best to keep the Calamity sealed until that day comes.<ref>{{Cite|It seems that my role is unfinished. There is still something I must do.|Zelda|BotW}}</ref>

One hundred years later, Link is awakened by the sound of Zelda's voice. Directed by Zelda, Impa, and the [[Spirit]] of King Rhoam, Link sets off to enter the Divine Beasts and free them from Ganon's control, and in the process, free the Spirits of the Champions.<ref>{{Cite|... {{Small|Link...}} Link. Thanks to you, all of the Divine Beasts have returned to us, and the spirits of the Champions are free.|Princess Zelda|BotW}}</ref> Should he do this successfully, the Divine Beasts fire upon Calamity Ganon during the final battle, dealing high damage and taking off up to half of its health. After Calamity Ganon is defeated, the spirits of the Champions and Rhoam watch Zelda and Link leave the castle before vanishing.

==Other Appearances==
==={{AoC|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
The Champions are recruited by [[Zelda]] to pilot the unearthed [[Divine Beast]]s to beat back [[Calamity Ganon]]; [[Mipha]] taking up [[Divine Beast Vah Ruta]], [[Daruk]] controlling [[Divine Beast Vah Rudania]], [[Revali]] taking [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]] under his wing, and [[Urbosa]] taking control of [[Divine Beast Vah Naboris]]. They travel around Hyrule to prepare for the upcoming battle against Calamity Ganon who was set to return at any time. All four Champions are playable [[Warrior]]s who can be chosen after they have been unlocked. Unlike what happened to them and the Divine Beasts in {{BotW|-}}, they survive their encounters with the Blight Ganons through [[Terrako]]'s Gates of Time which brings the adult [[Sidon]], along with [[Yunobo]], [[Teba]], and [[Riju]] from the future to their time to save them from suffering a fatal blow. Because of these events, the Champions retain control of their Divine Beasts and are able to actively participate in the battle to save Hyrule from Calamity Ganon and his seer, [[Astor]]. After Ganon was completely destroyed, the future warriors return to their own time as the surviving Champions look on with Princess Zelda, who isn't sealed with the monster, and Link who is also still standing strong and never had to be sent to the [[Shrine of Resurrection]].
{{Noncanon|End}}

==Trivia==
*During development, a [[Kokiri]] Champion was considered.<ref>{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 83}}</ref>
*Interestingly, if the [[Divine Beast]]s were not liberated by the time [[Link]] faces [[Calamity Ganon]] as well as the four Blight Ganons, the ending cutscene still shows the four Champions with [[King Rhoam]] floating in front of [[Hyrule Castle]] before they leave the mortal world. It can be implied that the destruction of the Phantom Ganons and [[Hyrule]] returning to its peaceful state has allowed the freedom of both the Champions and the Divine Beasts.<ref>{{Cite Web|author= Nn Li|published= Mar 16, 2017|retrieved= Nov. 6, 2022|url= https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=flcUjqDKpxM|title= Breath of the Wild: Calamity Ganon Fight (3 hearts, no Divine Beasts)|site= YouTube}}</ref>
*Link was intended to receive his own Divine Beast in the form of the [[Final Trial]] and the [[Master Cycle Zero]], but for unknown reasons this did not occur during the Calamity.
